stem.text: Aqueous $\text{NaOH}$ reacts with 1-bromopropane to give propan-1-ol.
What should be included in a diagram of the first step in the mechanism?

A.text: a curly arrow from a lone pair on the $\text{OH}^{-}$ ion to the $\text{C}^{\delta+}$ atom of 1-bromopropane

B.text: a curly arrow from the $\text{C}^{\delta+}$ atom of 1-bromopropane to the $\text{OH}^{-}$ ion

C.text: a curly arrow from the C–Br bond to the C atom

D.text: the homolytic fission of the C–Br bond
